name: Meia G
description: Meia G is a Brazilian-born artist working in New York. His paintings operate as spatial systems rather than images — chrome and controlled black grounds used to expose the instability of perception.
$hero: The landing image, and the preview when the site is shared. A chrome work is used deliberately: an R-02 field on a black page can read as an image that failed to load, and previews as a black rectangle on Instagram or in a message. Change to any id in works.json.
$selected: The landing sequence. Alternates chrome and field so the page has a rhythm rather than six near-identical black rectangles.
